name: Witch’s Gaze - The Vanishing Village
source:
Embark on a mystical quest that blends Slavic folklore with arcane witchcraft, uncover hidden secrets, and rescue a village lost to the shadows in this magical detective visual novel. Oh, and never forget your cat - he might save you!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3442950/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这部神奇的侦探视觉小说中，踏上融合了斯拉夫民间传说和神秘巫术的神秘任务，揭开隐藏的秘密，拯救一个迷失在阴影中的村庄。哦，永远不要忘记你的猫 - 他可能会救你！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3442950/]Steam[/url]]
